name: Bound and Beyond Public Company Limited
summary: Operating within Thailand's hospitality industry, Bound and Beyond Public Company Limited, along with its various subsidiaries, owns and manages hotels. Its significant assets include the Four Seasons Hotel Bangkok and Capella Bangkok, both of which it directly oversees. The company adopted its current name in October 2021, previously conducting business as Padaeng Industry Public Company Limited. Established in 1981, the firm maintains its corporate headquarters in Bangkok, Thailand.
